# Rare Puppers Co.

> Rare Puppers Co. is an indie studio building wholesome apps and games — a SnackPack Studios project within the SnackPack Universe. Its first release is PawsitiveDose, a free daily positivity app for Android with curated animal photos, encouraging quote cards, mood check-ins, a reviewed Daily Pawtrait, home-screen widgets, saved folders, and gentle reflection prompts. No endless feed, no third-party ads.

Key facts: PawsitiveDose is free on Google Play (Play Store ID: com.snackpackuniverse.pawsitivedose) with optional Pro features. The studio is part of the SnackPack Universe (snackpackuniverse.com). Contact: support@snackpackuniverse.com.
